WorkspaceHint: Absolute path to the project repo/folder. This is where .claude/ is loaded and .agents/automations.json is read.
MembersHint: Members are used to assign tickets. Automations target a member by slug (assigneeSlug field).
ColumnsHint: Kanban columns. Order is set via up/down arrows.
LocalModelHint: Configure an Ollama-compatible endpoint for local model dispatch. Set the proxy base URL (e.g. http://localhost:11434) and click Discover to verify the connection. Models can then be selected per action in the automation editor or per chat in the chat drawer.
FallbackModelHint: When an automation hits its model's usage limit (e.g. Sonnet weekly cap), the run is automatically retried with this model. Leave disabled to skip the fallback.
ModelsFound: model(s) available — select one in the automation editor or chat drawer
NoModelsFound: No models found. Make sure Ollama is running and models are pulled.
DeleteProjectWarning: All tickets and associated data will be permanently deleted. The workspace folder on disk is NOT deleted.
WorktreeSettingsHint: Opt-in mode: isolates agents by root ticket and serializes their local integration.
WorktreeEnableEffect: Child tickets share their root ticket worktree; disabled projects keep the standard flow.
WorktreePrerequisites: Prerequisites: usable Git code repository, git worktree available, and an existing local integration branch. Integration uses rebase + fast-forward with no automatic push.
RepositoryPathHint: Absolute path or path relative to the control workspace. Empty preserves the legacy workspace-based behavior.
